name: SaunaLife Model EE8G 6-Person ERGO Series Sauna Barrel
description: SaunaLife Model EE8G ERGO Series Sauna Barrel 79"L x 91"H (Diameter) Glass Front The SaunaLife ERGO-Series Elegance 8 outdoor sauna barrel was designed and engineered by sauna enthusiasts to be the most spacious, comfortable, durable, and attractive backyard sauna available. Ergonomics – Barrel Sauna Comfort When it comes to investing in an outdoor sauna barrel, comfort should be a top priority. While smaller barrels may be cheaper due to using fewer materials, there are significant downsides in terms of comfort. This includes lower door height, limited headroom, and lower-quality benches. Additionally, the tight arc of a small barrel can negatively impact bather posture and require bending when entering and exiting. At 7'7" in diameter and 6'7" in length, the SaunaLife Model EE8G offers spacious room for comfortable standing. The ergonomically contoured benches and generous barrel arc provide excellent lumbar support and a natural seating position. Made with luxurious Thermo-Aspen wood that is 50% thicker than other saunas, this knot-free and thermally ideal material ensures a silky-smooth and comfortable experience. The sauna is equipped with an 8mm tempered glass wall that allows natural light to fill the spacious interior and highlights its roominess. The exterior of the barrel is constructed with full-length spruce staves that are thermally enhanced for increased strength, dimensional stability, and the ability to withstand weather conditions. A fitted floor provides secure and level footing for added safety. Durability – A lifetime of outdoor bathing pleasure "Thermo-Spruce" is the process of naturally treating wood with pressurized heat and steam for increased longevity. The SaunaLife barrel is built with 1.65” thick full-length Thermo-Spruce staves, known for their durability and excellent thermal resistance (R-value). This eco-friendly wood is free of chemicals and perfect for outdoor saunas. Ingenuity - Engineered to exceed expectations This sauna barrel boasts exceptional engineering, making assembly effortless and equipping it with cutting-edge features. It's designed to withstand water exposure, featuring unrivaled 1-7/8” wide and 1/8” thick stainless steel bands that tightly hold the large staves. The SaunaLife Model EE8G ERGO Series Sauna Barrel, with its watertight shingle kit and drip rails, offers superior rainwater control and ensures that bathers remain dry regardless of weather conditions. The sauna also features two-floor drains, one conveniently located under the heater for easy water disposal and the other near the door for draining cold plunge or pool water. Illumination – Inside and out Enhance your sauna experience with the SaunaLife Model EE8G ERGO Series Sauna Barrel's elegant dotless white LED lighting system. This Wi-Fi app-based system allows for infinite adjustment and comes with a hand-held remote for easy on/off/dim operation. SaunaLife's white LED fixture is certified for heat and water (IP67) and has a dotless design for a seamless, consistent glow. Check out the E Sconce+ Package for two eye-catching outdoor LED wall sconces and an additional LED lightbar for interior illumination. Enhance your sauna experience with the E MOOD Chromotherapy Lighting Package for unlimited color options. Beauty – A compliment to almost any outdoor oasis Crafted in Northern Europe, the SaunaLife Model E6 is designed for home use and integrates seamlessly with everyday health and wellness routines. Experience a lifetime of health and well-being in the comfort of your own backyard with the SaunaLife Model EE8G ERGO Series Sauna Barrel. The EE8G Black includes outdoor black paint for customer application after delivery. The paint is recommended to be reapplied annually as needed to maintain the finish. Applying the paint after delivery allows for a smooth, even finish and helps avoid scratches or nicks that can occur during LTL freight shipping.
